reviews.text: Staff is amazing and very knowledgeable! They saved our cat's life and prevented a major surgery!
They treat your pet like it's their own

Central Animal  Hospital literally saved my cat’s life. They had great follow through. Everyone from the front desk staff to vet techs, groomer, and the vets themselves are truly wonderful, outstanding, compassionate, great with dogs and cats, very knowledgeable, great with people, above and beyond in their helpfulness and all at reasonable prices.  After each appointment, they called the next day to check on my cat.
They stabilized his health and turned it around for the better and followed up to ensure he stayed in good health. This is my go to vet hospital and back up to my regular vet for whenever my pet needs more specialized care and expertise. They also do regular pet grooming and regular vet visits too.  Truly a gem for pet care in Houston.

Incredibly kind staff who were able to take in my kitty after her regular vet was booked up. They were very thorough in their diagnostics and were transparent with pricing. Most of all, they treated my kitty with such kindness and compassion!

This vet offered to work with CAP (charity for animals) for a free animal checkup but because I adopted on a weekend, I missed the 72 hour window by 6-7 hours (they’re closed on Sundays!).

The mgr told me he could see my pet but “for a fee” and my response is, “Why on earth would I pay you one cent for any service, if you can’t manage to maintain your word in the beginning?!”

(I’m good - I will find a reputable vet.)

My advice to the consumer is to find a veterinarian that actually cares about the community.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Dr. Reed is very attentive and answered all my questions. She was able to diagnose my dog’s issues and get her treated fast
I brought my two outside cats and the staff and Dr Smith were very kind and patient with them.

I brought my lab and golden retriever for a walk in visit and Dr Reid and the technician Dennis were absolutely amazing! Dr Reid is patient and attentive. It was the first time a vet mentioned medication to my 11 yo lab to manage daily arthritis pain. Most vets in the past have only recommended daily supplements making us think it is a common issue. I am happy to have found this place!
Been coming here for over a decade, great place, great doctors.

The staff was nice but it was an extremely expensive visit and the problem only worsened. For $400 we received an exam and 2 shots. 10 days later I had to bring my kitty to alief animal hospital where he received a catheter and 5 day stay for monitoring :( included in the visit at alief was prescription diet medication, the procedure, the initial exam ($35 by the way!!) and follow up medications. again nice team but idk if it gives it’s bang for the buck.

Whelp, looks like we found a new vet home. Great experience. I came in with a kitten rescue (Dolly) and everyone from the young lady that answered the phone, to the lovely vet tech, and Dr. Smith, we’re all exceptional. Stop reading this review and bring your fur baby! You won’t regret it.
Everyone here is fantastic.

We recently moved to the area and my dog wasn’t handling the move well, so we had to find a vet pretty quickly. They were so accommodating at getting us seen, and every person we’ve interacted with has been so kind. My pup ended up with an infection also that needed a tooth extraction, so within three months she’s been I think four times (including being put under for the extractions), and I couldn’t be happier with this veterinarian office. I’ve never felt rushed, and the doctors actually take time to talk to you about your concerns. All of the techs are animal lovers and treat my Kodi so well! We love CHAH!
Excellent care for my dogs. I would definitely recommend.
My regular Vet wasn’t available the day I had an emergency. They suggested Central Houston Animal Hospital. And they saved the day. Thank you CHAH !!

I just love bringing my dog here, they welcome him in everytime and takes care of him and the staff are so supportive and nice and today Bianca was very helpful and kind. I been coming here since 2024 and never had a problem. Thank you Central
Animal Hospital for your help and love you show my dog
They are kind, quick, and attentive to detail.

I have been a diehard fan of CHAH since I first got my dog as a puppy and brought her here in 2017. I recommended anyone who wanted a vet recommendation to go here because I thought the vets cared and I liked that it wasn't trying upsell like some vets I've experienced. Even when we've moved further from here where it was no longer convenient, I still tried very hard to convince my husband to keep going here.

The Vet Techs and the front office staff have always been nothing short of amazing. I have no complaints with how responsive and warm they've been.

With that being said, it breaks my heart that I fear I will have to be looking for a new vet. My dog usually has bad anxiety at the vet and it's gotten terribly worse recently as she's gotten older. Instead of meeting it with patience and understanding, we got the opposite. As pawrents, we're not opposed to doing anything that would be in the best interest of our dog and some tact would have been appreciated. The bedside manners of our doctor recently has been disappointing considering we've gone to her many times in the past. What used to be a friendly bright greeting with our dog and helpful insight has now transitioned to being short with her answers and noticeably irritated. When seeking understanding of why she recommended a product over another for curiosity, we were met with "I just do and you can look at that on our website". We chalked it up to a bad day as the office was chaotic running behind with road closures, we get it.

The nail on the coffin was when receiving the results over the phone on a different day, and I was met with nothing but passive answers. I was trying to seek understanding as to why my dogs results were abnormal as this was not the first time she's received similar results and I wanted to know if there was a concerning pattern. My mind was foggy as I was trying to recall the history on the spot of her visits and instead of "I'll look into that for you or have someone do that", it was met with "no, I don't know what you're talking about. if you don't want to take your dog to the vet for a follow up then thats your choice" kind of attitude. I felt like I was gaslit instead of talking to someone who wanted to be helpful. I would like to think that I wasn't being difficult and it no longer felt like a safe space to get any understanding of my dog's situation. Her solution was to send the lab results over and I could look at it myself. So now I have questions left unanswered and feeling like the one professional I should be talking to is too annoyed to answer.
Great Clinic!!! Very helpful

We love CHAH! My dogs have been coming here for years and it’s always been an enjoyable experience with the staff and doctors. Carrie is our favorite groomer.  She makes our pups look amazing, and they come back happy from a non stressful grooming!!

Such a great and friendly staff! Very accommodating and we were able to get a same day appointment! Would definitely recommend to anyone with a pet! They took care of my cat and were just very amazing!
Wonderful treatment of our cat for an ear infection. Will be back when we have these unfortunate issues again.

*Our previous vet called us and requested that we remove the negative review we left for their office...they did not want to discuss the fact that they didn't diagnose our cat properly they just wanted the review deleted* We have been here at CHAH for 2 weeks now and we cannot say enough good things about this facility! The vet we were at for the last 3 years spent 10 minutes with our cat who was lethargic and not eating and said, "It's lymphoma you should think about euthanasia is that something you're ok with doing today?" No testing, no offer of any other treatment they just wanted to know if we could euthanize immediately. We were obviously shell shocked and immediately called CHAH for a 2nd opinion. They saw us immediately less than 24 hours after we called them and Dr. Faulkner and staff were AMAZING! She took the time to walk us through a tentative diagnosis of FIP (feline corona virus) and gave us a solid plan for testing and treatment and they worked a miracle on Twix! They were very up front with pricing and made sure we knew that this was treatable but still touch and go because our baby had been sick for a couple of weeks thanks to our old vet dismissing his symptoms. The FIP treatment is brand new and we are so incredibly grateful that we landed with Dr. Faulkner and everyone at CHAH because they care about staying up to date on veterinary medicine! They taught us how to provide supportive care at home with fluids and nausea meds along with the groundbreaking FIP meds and they are constantly making sure he is doing well which means the world to us! Our baby is up and walking around and playing again and we are extremely positive about his continued recovery! We understand we still may lose him but CHAH has given him a fighting chance! Thank you CHAH!!

I cannot thank Central Houston Animal Hospital enough for what theyve done for me and my cat. My old vet saw my cat who was lethargic, barely eating and had fluid build up barely tested him and diagnosed him with lymphoma after 20 minutes and told me straight up there was nothing i could possibly do and i needed to put him down as soon as possible. i discovered chah through scouring reviews and decided this would be a good place for a second opinion. we were able to book a next-day appointment and the booking and check in was a smooth process! they were shocked my vet told me this and immediately started working on a treatment and diagnostic plan for my baby. the technician and doctor were so friendly with us and explained their thought process in detail making sure we understood absolutely everything about his condition. i am so so thankful they immediately jumped to getting him as much help as possible starting him on antibiotics, fluids, and multiple tests + an ultrasound instead of just going No sorry put him down like my old vet. They were incredibly compassionate and have given him a second chance. Even if we still have to say goodbye soon, this was the nicest experience i could of ever hoped for in my circumstances and im so so grateful i decided to call them! I will definitely start seeing my other healthy cat here regularly as well! The front desk is also very nice in person and on the phone and they triple check and break down the cost of your bills before going through with anything. I will never ever forget this thank you so much guys!!

Great people and service
🙏 …

My sweet little Alice wasn't feeling so well and she see CHAH's office partner for physical therapy every week.  I called to see if CHAH would see her to do a few tests while she was with the Rehab facility and even though she was not a patient of CHAH directly, they cared so much and got her in while she was at her drop of with their partner.  I'm so thankful for CHAH responsiveness and care to ensure Alice had a prompt diagnosis.
Allegro has been in good hands for over 10 years. I feel confident in the care he receives. Q&A during each appt. is greatly appreciated.
Staff are amazing!!

We were referred by family to see Dr. Smith & Dr Reid. They have been taking care of our fur baby for the past couple of months. Both doctors are personable, knowledgeable and always mindful of our budget. The staff here has great customer service, we highly recommend this office!

This place is great! Taking your pet to the vet can be so stressful, for both parties, but they make it so easy here! They are so friendly and make sure you understand your pets needs. They don’t try to upsell you. They are helpful and kind. I highly recommend!
Stellar service and very effective. Highly recommend. Caring and they listen

Excellent quality of care !!! Very clean and Luna and I love the friendliness of everyone
They try to accommodate everyone needs !!
I really liked this place. I am going to continue to take my orange kitty slim there. They were so good with her and she wasn’t scared!
Took my one year old cat here for his first vet visit a couple days ago and everything was perfect. The staff was so so nice, gave me great advice, and they got along with my cat so well! 10/10!

The dog groomer at CHAH went above and beyond to communicate with us about our special needs dog and the special treatment she received to keep her calm. I really felt how much she cares about my Duchess Kate.
Thank you so much! First class staff and Vet Clinic.
I moved in the area and needed a new vet for my baby. I found CHAH and been coming ever since. Dr reed is awesome and very helpful. Staff is super friendly.
Great staff. Very caring and always remembers my baby by name. We love coming here for both regular veterinary services and for Bounce Rehab.
This place is full of caring professionals who work with you where you are.

I urgently needed a next day appointment for my cat after she had been in the ER for the two days previous. Being new to this city this was a stressful situation to find myself in. CHAH was not only able to see us the next day, but the care and attention demonstrated to my cat and I made for a calming and positive experience. I highly recommend.
Love the service here! I take my cats to Natalie and the staff is always friendly, accommodating, and punctual.
Thank you for your positive rating! We're delighted to know you had a great experience with us.
Excellent veterinary services. Staff very customer oriented. Consistent follow-up after each visit
Best vet ever!
We have been with CHAH for years and have always had a good experience.

I had to get a last minute appointment here because of an incident with my puppy. It was the most stressful morning but oddly enough, I’m grateful for that experience because I would’ve never stumbled on CHAH.

Everyone here was genuinely so helpful, friendly, and accommodating to my puppy and I. Dr. Reid addressed all my concerns and gave me the assurance I needed — incredibly knowledgeable and truly cares for her patients. A big shoutout also to Ms. Carrie and Ms. Virginia as well.

Safe to say, I think Remy and I have found our primary vet! Thank you, CHAH team!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
Really great place to bring your pet. Great, friendly staff…very accommodating.
My two dogs have been patients for almost 10 years, and we love it here!
They’ve been taking great care of my doodle for almost 5 years!

My Bomber is in renal failure, and he was a drop-off for Dr. Faulkner for a checkup.  She and her tech communicated with me throughout the day, and I very much appreciated her respecting how I wanted my baby vetted.  Any vet I've seen here is very professional, knowledgeable, and explains my pet's current condition.  The front desk staff is very friendly, and the drop off option is super convenient.

Love this animal clinic. They are prompt, compassionate, responsive, and up front about the cost. More than once CHAH has worked in my cats on an urgent basis. Importantly, it’s not just the docs who are excellent. The assistants and front desk staff are “on it” as well. I’ve left more than one animal clinic when I liked the vets but their staff were so challenging to deal with. Not here! My cats and I are patients for life.
Vet appt with 12 week old puppy.  Very friendly staff.  Thorough evaluation.  Lots of attention to details!

We have been coming to Central Houston Animal Hospital for years, first with Rory and now with Tango.  All the staff and vets are wonderful!  They have fabulous pawside manner and are also good with human parents.  We especially love Dr. Reid, who helped us tremendously with Rory, who had chronic GI problems and then bladder cancer.  We cannot recommend these people and this place highly enough!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

Lori and the other staff at the front desk are all very personable and professional and eager to assist you and your pet. Dr Faulkner was easy to talk with and conveyed health information about my cat in a concise manner.
Awesome place where your beloved pets aren’t just pets but family, and they get treated with dignity. Attentive staff, cordial environment, top notch Vets. Highly recommended!

Both of our pups got an upset stomach and the clinic offered the drop off option for them to be checked same day. They called me to discuss an estimate beforehand. Dr Reed checked and treated them promptly. Great customer service and they treats our dogs like family.
Best doctors and staff, friendly, professional and always treat our pups like family.
Wonderful experience for both me and my dog. Thanjs

If you care about your animals I sincerely urge you to find another vet that actually cares about more than just money. I understand that money is important to running a business but the focus should be the animal first.

Everyone is always super nice and accommodating here, I've never had a bad experience and our dogs get a lot of love and care! Besides caring for our dogs more chronic needs we've also experienced the great help that has been the rehabilitation center. Amazing work here on all fronts!
Excellent care in every respect.
Amazing service!
This is the best vet hospital. Every single staff members starting from front desk to the back are friendly, pleasant, compassionate and competent.

We were looking for a new vet for our puppy. The reviews of Central Houston Animal Hospital were amazing so we gave it a shot. Had a wonderful experience. New pup was treated extra special and so were we. Thank you!
Darcy Reid has been an awesome vet for our cats and dogs.
The team was amazing! Thank you for your patience and care and making me feel comfortable
All of the doctors have been so kind to me and my sweet Ruby. Everyone in that office really makes you feel you’re in great hands. Highly recommend coming here.

Dr. Reid and your team take great care of Zoey!
Thank you,
Martha Yates
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.
great staff and great attention to care. very patient with my aggressive/stressed out dog

We were sent here by our vet for a possible emergency and the staff were so sweet and caring. The vet was very knowledgeable and explained everything clearly. Had our little guy feeling better super fast. Prices were super affordable. I loved how easy it was to schedule a same day appointment as a new patient. The staff even called the next day to check how our little one was doing. Will definitely be switching to this practice for now on! 🌟
Always above expectations..!
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you had a positive experience with us.

We are beyond grateful to the amazing team at CHAH (Kristina, Dr. Marziani, Kassendra, Chloe, Michelle, Katelin, Sharon and Clint)  for their incredible support in helping our paralyzed puppy, Gizmo, walk again. Words can hardly express how thankful we are for everything they did. The team was caring, encouraging, and always provided us with hope throughout the journey. A special thank you to the wonderful staff at the reception area who greeted us with a smile each time we came for physical therapy. Your kindness made a world of difference. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Thank you to Carrie who took such great care when grooming Gizmo !

Smokey is our third pet to be cared for at
Central Houston Animal Hospital!
We feel that the veterinarians and staff care very much for the welfare of animals brought to them.
They are always helpful and go the extra mile for the pets.
I recommend Central Houston Animal Hospital for all pet owners 😸
